summary: Verified Next.js 16 middleware->proxy conflict fix at /app root. Ran `npx next build`; build compiled successfully and exited 0. No 'Both middleware file' error. /app/src/middleware.ts is deleted; /app/src/proxy.ts exists with default export `proxy(request: NextRequest)` and `export const config` matcher. Build output lists 'Proxy (Middleware)' as single entry. Only unrelated pre-existing warning about /api/cron/refresh route exporting a `config` object (route-segment-config deprecation) remains — not a failure per request.

minor.issue: Route exports deprecated `config` object; Turbopack warns to use individual exports (schedule etc). Non-blocking, pre-existing, unrelated to this fix.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Migrate /app/src/app/api/cron/refresh/route.ts away from the deprecated `export const config = { schedule: ... }` pattern to Next.js route-segment individual exports or move cron schedule to vercel.json.
critical_code_review_comments: proxy.ts correctly wraps auth0.middleware with try/catch and normalizes non-NextResponse returns via NextResponse.next().
config.matcher preserves original middleware exclusions (_next/static, _next/image, favicon.ico, sitemap.xml, robots.txt).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration covered the Next.js app at /app root (separate from /app/frontend + /app/backend). Build passes cleanly with Next.js 16.2.12 + Turbopack. Prior iterations 1-4 relate to the React+FastAPI app.
rca of the issue: Next.js 16 renamed the edge middleware convention from middleware.ts to proxy.ts. Having both files present triggers a static file-detection error before compile. Fix: delete src/middleware.ts and consolidate the error-handling wrapper + auth0.middleware delegation + matcher into src/proxy.ts as the default export. Verified by successful `next build`.
